title: observability: token/kv cost & latency dashboards + tracing + alert tuning
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Add token-level and KV cache observability dashboards; new tracing span tags for request routing and kv-cache; tuned alert thresholds for token-cost and tail latency. No behavioral changes to runtime.
description:
Context: Customers and SRE have asked for better visibility into per-token cost and tail latency, and for correlating KV-cache behavior with request-level latency and errors. This PR builds on the token-level observability work (see ENG-1124) and adds KV-specific metrics, trace instrumentation, dashboard panels, and alert tuning. Goals: 1) expose token-level cost and latency breakdowns by model, route, and customer; 2) add KV-cache hit/miss metrics and per-request kv contribution to latency/cost; 3) surface distributed tracing spans with routing and cache metadata; 4) update Grafana dashboards and alerting thresholds to reduce noise and catch regressions earlier.

What I changed (high level):
- Metrics: added new Prometheus metrics and labels: rwi_token_cost_usd_total, rwi_token_latency_ms_bucketed, rwi_kv_cache_hits_total, rwi_kv_cache_misses_total, rwi_kv_latency_ms_sum. Metrics include labels: model, route, customer_id (redacted), deployment_tier, batch_size, kv_policy.
- Tracing: added span attributes for route_id, model_variant, kv_cache.hit (bool), kv_cache.policy, request_routing_path; increased trace sampling for requests that hit tail-latency thresholds.
- Dashboards: new Grafana dashboard JSONs (token-kv-cost-latency.json) with panels for per-token cost, tail latency P95/P99 by model & route, kv hit ratio heatmap, kv-induced latency contribution, and a combined cost vs latency scatter panel for recent 24h workloads.
- Alerts: tuned existing alerts and added new ones: TokenCostRateChange, TokenTailLatencyRegression, KVHitRatioDrop, KVLatencySpike. Alerts include runbook links and severity labels. Thresholds chosen to reduce previous false positives (see alert rationale below).
- Instrumentation docs: updated observability/README.md with metric/trace conventions and Grafana dashboard notes.

Testing and CI:

- Ran end-to-end smoke in perf-canary: validated dashboard panels populated with synthetic traffic and kv hit/miss scenarios.

Review discussion (summary):
- Diego: asked for customer_id redaction by default to avoid PII in metrics. I updated exporters to use hashed_customer_id and added note in README about opt-in raw IDs for enterprise (needs config flag). Diego approved after change.
- Priya: requested clearer runbook steps for TokenTailLatencyRegression, including how to fallback routes and check KV cache warmup. I extended runbook with step-by-step diagnostics and added a dashboard link. Priya approved with minor comments.
- Jonas: raised concern about alert noise; requested threshold calibration using 90-day baseline and an initial suppression window after deploy. I implemented a 1-hour suppression for newly deployed model variants and added baseline-based thresholds in alert rules. Jonas approved.
- SRE: ran a small canary in staging for 48 hours; suggested lowering KVLatencySpike sensitivity for low-traffic routes \u2014 adjusted to include traffic_min_samples label.

CI checks (final run):
- cargo test: pass

- grafana lint (json schema): pass
- prometheus rule validation: pass

Merge outcome: Squash-merged after approvals from Diego and Priya, passing CI, and a successful 48h staging canary. Release notes added to changelog.

Notes and rationale for alert thresholds (short):
- TokenCostRateChange: triggers if per-route token cost rate increases by >20% vs 90-day median with p<0.01, and min traffic > 10k tokens/min to avoid noise from low-volume routes.
- TokenTailLatencyRegression: fires when P99 latency increases by >30% vs baseline for 15m sustained and minQPS > 1. Includes automatic trace sampling at onset to capture traces for diagnosis.
- KVHitRatioDrop: triggers when KV hit ratio drops below 85% (with min samples) for 30m; correlated with KVLatencySpike to avoid duplicate alerts.

Follow-ups / future work:
- Add per-customer billing attribution pipeline to feed cost metrics into billing (ENG-1209).
- Explore histogram-based prometheus buckets for per-token latency to reduce cardinality while preserving tail info.
